indications: Lidomax™ is indicated for topical analgesia as directed by a healthcare provider.
contraindications: Apply a thin layer to the affected area 3 to 4 times daily or as directed by a healthcare provider. For external use only.
warningsAndPrecautions: Lidomax™ (Lidocaine HCl 2%) is supplied as a clear topical gel in a 3 oz (85 g) tube.  NDC 85477-304-07
name: Lidomax
